```artifact Decision Table for Unit U14_Self_Test | Condition / Input | Action / Output | |---------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | [RW-SW-1] O2 sensor accuracy test | 1. Command O2 sensor to measure at known O₂ concentration (e.g., 40000 ppm).
2. Verify measured value is within ±200 ppm of expected.
3. If within tolerance, mark PASS; else, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-2] Blower response validation | 1. Set blower to speed S1 (lowest speed).
2. Measure pressure at outlet.
3. Verify pressure is ≥ Pmin (e.g., 5 mmHg) and ≤ Pmax (e.g., 15 mmHg).
4. Repeat for speeds S2, S3, S4 (highest speed).
5. If all speeds meet pressure bounds, mark PASS; else, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-3] Pinch valve pressure test | 1. Fix blower at speed S3.
2. Open pinch valve fully.
3. Measure pressure; verify it is ≥ Pmin and ≤ Pmax.
4. Close pinch valve partially and measure again; verify pressure drop is within 2 mmHg tolerance.
5. If both checks pass, mark PASS; else, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-159] Audible alarm validation | 1. Apply test voltage (e.g., 5V) to all audible alarm devices.
2. Check for current flow using a multimeter; expect >0 mA.
3. Simulate alarm trigger (e.g., send digital signal).
4. Verify sound level ≥ 80 dB at 1 m distance using sound level meter.
5. If all checks pass, mark PASS; else, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-160] Visual alarm validation | 1. Power on all visual alarm LEDs.
2. Verify each LED lights up (expected status code 0x01).
3. Simulate alarm trigger (e.g., send GPIO high).
4. Verify LED brightness ≥ 70% of max (measured with lux meter).
5. If all checks pass, mark PASS; else, mark FAIL. | Negative / Error Condition Tests: | Condition / Input | Action / Output | |---------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | [RW-SW-1] O2 sensor failure | 1. Command O2 sensor to measure.
2. Check for no response or error code (e.g., 0xFF).
3. If error detected, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-2] Blower malfunction | 1. Set blower to highest speed.
2. Verify pressure is outside Pmin–Pmax range (e.g., <4 mmHg or >16 mmHg).
3. If out of range, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-3] Pinch valve stuck | 1. Fix blower at speed S3.
2. Open pinch valve fully and measure pressure; expect no change from closed state.
3. If pressure does not change, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-159] Audible alarm non‑functional | 1. Apply test voltage.
2. Check for no current (<0.1 mA).
3. If no current, mark FAIL. | | [RW-SW-160] Visual alarm non‑functional | 1. Power on visual alarms.
2. Verify no LED illumination (status code 0x00).
3. If no light, mark FAIL. | Boundary Value Tests: | Condition / Input | Action / Output | |---------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | [RW-SW-2] Blower speed limits | Test at speeds exactly at min (S1) and max (S4) and one intermediate (S2, S3). Verify pressure stays within bounds. | | [RW-SW-3] Pinch valve pressure limits | Test at pressures exactly at Pmin and Pmax when valve is partially open; verify system responds correctly. | | [RW-SW-159] Audible alarm thresholds | Test alarm activation at minimum and maximum allowable voltage levels (e.g., 4.5V and 5.5V). | | [RW-SW-160] Visual alarm brightness | Test LED brightness at minimum (30%) and maximum (100%) levels using calibrated lux meter. | Automated Verification Steps: 1. **O2 Sensor Accuracy**: Use a calibrated gas generator to set O₂ concentration; compare measured vs. expected within ±200 ppm. 2. **Blower Response**: Employ pressure transducer linked to a data logger to capture pressure at each speed; validate against predefined thresholds. 3. **Pinch Valve Pressure**: Utilize a programmable valve controller to modulate flow; log pressure changes in real-time. 4. **Audible Alarm**: Interface with a sound level meter via USB; trigger alarm and assert dB level ≥ 80 dB. 5. **Visual Alarm**: Connect LEDs to a microcontroller; assert GPIO state and measure lux to confirm ≥ 70% brightness.
